inheritance_rule: ALL RULES FROM V1 REVISION 3 REMAIN MANDATORY UNLESS THIS FILE EXPLICITLY STRENGTHENS THEM
purpose: Guarantee persistent QROS execution plus mandatory human-first communication across manual chats, future chats and automation wakeups.

continuation_behavior.when_user_says_continue: Recover latest verifiable checkpoint, explain the resumed point in simple language, then execute automatically without asking again.
continuation_behavior.when_user_is_active: Interactive foreground has priority; continue research to the maximum safe boundary and report in human-first format.
continuation_behavior.when_user_is_idle: Hourly automation may fill idle gaps and must use the same human-first format for any notification.
continuation_behavior.material_proposal_behavior: Before presenting any material architecture/system/improvement, run the Best Proposal Compiler pipeline to DESIGN_FIXED_POINT; do not rely on the user to request a separate audit.
continuation_behavior.cws_rule: For prolonged non-economic QROS work, chat must hand off to CWS/DEK durable execution. Do not use the chat as the continuity owner or long-running worker.
continuation_behavior.global_execution_routing: All QROS execution classes must route through CWS+DEK. CWS is continuity/scheduling governor only; scientific and economic permissions remain external durable capabilities and missing capabilities fail closed.

best_proposal_compiler.presentation_rule: DO_NOT_SHOW_RAW_IDEA; PRESENT_AUDITED_CANDIDATE_ONLY; LIVENESS/CONTINUITY DESIGNS MUST PASS SELF_APPLICATION_GATE
